body:
# Catboy

Impact: 2

Just a regular human if you don't count the ears and the tail... (my God why did i make this)

## Powers

### Carnivore

Your sharp teeth make it so you can only eat meat. Also, fish saturates you more.

### Fisher

Because you cant't have a job, you just fish and make fishing rods all day, making you an expert in the field.

### Fragile

You are a bit weaker than others.

### Meow

You can purr, hiss and meow for some reason, which you enjoy to do.

### Nocturnal

Your feline eyes make you see better at night.

### Not a Swimmer

Cats and water don't go along that well, thus you can't swim.

### Paws

Your paws tone fall damage down.

### Pounce

You can leap forward to get closer to foes.

### Swift

You can move more swiftly than others.
